description: Displays a chronological timeline of activity entries (comments, status changes, assignments, attachments) with author avatars, relative timestamps, and color-coded connector dots per entry type. Entries are sorted newest-first.

parameters.name: Entries
parameters.description: Timeline entries to display. Sorted newest-first. Ignored when DataProvider is set.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Whether the timeline is loading data.

parameters.name: ShowInternal
parameters.description: Whether internal entries are included (default: true — the activity timeline shows everything).

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Optional free-text filter applied to author, content, and entry type (additive, default: none).

parameters.name: EntryTypeFilter
parameters.description: Optional entry-type filter (e.g. "comment"); null/empty shows all types (additive, default: none).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Page size for incremental "load more" paging. null (default) shows every entry — backward compatible.

parameters.name: EntryTypeFilterOptions
parameters.description: Optional explicit set of entry-type options for the filter bar. When null, distinct types are derived from Entries.

parameters.name: ShowFilterBar
parameters.description: When true, renders a built-in search + type filter bar (default: false).

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Optional async data provider. When set, entries are fetched (filtered + paged) from it instead of Entries.

examples.title: With ref for programmatic refresh
examples.code:
<TmActivityTimeline @ref="_timelineRef" Entries="@entries" />

@code {
    private TmActivityTimeline? _timelineRef;
    async Task Refresh() => await _timelineRef!.RefreshAsync();
}
